name: Canvas Launch
description: A launch page for a design tool, told in four acts on pinned scenes that hand over in place: the promise on a live editor, any project on the board, real elements and component variants, Magic Cast shot like a film, the assistant rebuilding from references and recreating a live page, a gravity wall of models, and a 3D gallery behind the ask. Built from the editor's own components. Light and dark, every colour a CSS variable.
designedFor: Launching a developer or design tool with a story rather than a feature grid
Showing a product's real interface, drawn in code so it stays sharp at any zoom
Waitlist and early-access pages that need one clear ask at the end
Studying pinned, scroll-triggered scenes built with Framer Motion and Lenis
